fusions.name: Thrown Grapnel
fusions.desc: Throws a grapnel on a length of links that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Yank It Taut
fusions.desc: A wrenching strike that deals 16 damage and tears out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one. The torn wound is [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and the target moves 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Windlass
fusions.desc: Stakes a winched line 6 tiles long for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Trailing Links
fusions.desc: When you strike, a barbed link flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 4 seconds.
